cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 wrappers announce professionalism but do not supply an expert method; D17 disaster rationalisation is strong.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 single registrant causes A3 catering savings; B4 lift-only visitor causes A5 self-bidding.

relationship.evidence: B2 debt and B4 actual reason for attendance are practical objections to A plan.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands debt to protect the donation rather than admit the original problem.

specificity.evidence: A1 advance and B2 five thousand borrowing state the financial stakes.
